attribution: Neuromorphometrics labels (MICCAI 2012; SPM12; CC BY-NC) moved into ICBM 2009 space; MASSP 2.0 nuclei (Bazin et al. 2020, 2025; TemplateFlow); Juelich histological atlas tracts (FSL); brainstem divisions approximate; cranial nerve nuclei and cranial nerve courses schematic; fibre lines are illustrative streamlines drawn inside the atlas tract masks (not tractography). Population-average anatomy, not an individual brain.

arteries.attribution: Arteries: teaching model of the typical configuration, drawn by NeuroUnknown on landmarks and sulci of this template (arteries3d.py); calibres rounded from Rhoton 2000 and 2002 and Mouches and Forkert 2019. Not an individual's anatomy and not for planning surgery.

spine.attribution: Spine: teaching model drawn by NeuroUnknown (spine3d.py) from published measurements: cord segment lengths and diameters (Frostell 2016), cord length (Ko 2004), standing alignment (Sardar 2022, Yukawa 2018). Vertebral shapes are approximate typical proportions. Not an individual's anatomy.

paths.attribution: Long pathways: illustrative fibre lines drawn by NeuroUnknown (longtracts.py) along standard neuroanatomical routes, on waypoints placed in this template and on the tract positions of the cord model. Not tractography.

skull.attribution: Skull: vault, skull base and upper face traced from the CT template of Rorden et al. 2012 (BSD licence) registered to this template; inner table from the ICBM 2009 brain and CSF maps; jaws, teeth, mastoid tips and occipital condyles drawn by NeuroUnknown with typical proportions. Eyes fitted to the ICBM 2009b T1. Not an individual's anatomy.

meninges.attribution: Meninges: dura and arachnoid follow the inner surface of the cranial cavity and the pia the brain surface of the ICBM 2009 templates; falx and tentorium placed midway between the hemispheres and between cerebrum and cerebellum of this atlas; CSF flow lines, granulations and needles drawn by NeuroUnknown along textbook routes. Illustrative, not an individual's anatomy.
